claim_rules.fourier: shared abstraction only under full six-condition success rule; uniqueness prohibited
claim_rules.packing: procedure-relative lower bound and key secondary

fourier.aggregation: within comparison set, aligned minus each control on the primary outcome; then teacher-seed paired summaries separately by phase and hard/soft condition
fourier.alignment: fit source and recipient linear task-code subspaces and an orthogonal Procrustes map in float64 on the fixed training-domain split only; deterministic SVD/sign convention; no test trials or outcome logits enter fitting
fourier.capacity: same ordered support of four complex modes/eight real degrees of freedom with identical conjugate bookkeeping, fitted rank, float32 write precision, recipient write budget, identifier count, and side-information bytes for aligned plus all five controls
fourier.expected_behavior: the intervened recipient should move from its intact base behavior toward its own intact behavior on the canonical counterfactual input, changing the predicted result from s to s_d while preserving the recipient network's centered-logit pattern for that counterfactual
fourier.interchanged_variable: the projected internal code for the modular sum s=(x+y) mod p on the four primary diagonal harmonics
fourier.internal_location: final-token blocks.0.mlp.hook_post, after the nonlinear MLP activation and before W_out writes into the residual stream
fourier.intervention_formula: h_rec_intervened = h_rec_base - P_rec(h_rec_base) + A(P_src(h_src_donor)), at the frozen MLP-post location; P_rec and P_src are fixed fitted task-code projections and A is the fixed capacity-bounded source-to-recipient alignment
fourier.location_justification: modular-addition task variables are expected to be synthesized in nonlinear MLP features; intervention before W_out tests an internal causal state and leaves the recipient's W_out, residual addition, normalization, and unembedding to translate that state into behavior
fourier.mode_justification: for any function g(x+y mod p), the 2-D Fourier transform is supported on the diagonal frequency pairs (k,k) under the frozen negative-exponent DFT convention because character_k(x+y)=character_k(x) character_k(y); the first four nonzero diagonal harmonics are fixed without observing activations or outcomes
fourier.pair_rule: for each seed 0-14, each primary phase, and each hard/soft condition, source is the direct teacher and recipient is the lowest fixed initialization slot that is eligible; if none is eligible the pair is unavailable and is not replaced

primary_outcome.centering: C subtracts the per-input class mean
primary_outcome.interpretation: 1 is exact recipient-counterfactual behavior; 0 is no displacement from intact base; negative values are retained
primary_outcome.name: counterfactual_centered_logit_displacement_fidelity
primary_outcome.zero_denominator: trial unavailable and reported, never epsilon-regularized

fourier.representation: unitary 2-D DFT over the ordered modular input grid; complex coefficients stored as ordered real/imaginary pairs with conjugate partners implied by real activations
secondary_outcomes: base-behavior preservation on matched no-change trials
fourier.success_rule: shared-causal-abstraction claim eligible only when aligned exceeds every one of the five controls under the predeclared teacher-seed interval rule, counterfactual argmax is favorable, no-change preservation passes, and the comparison inventory is complete; otherwise not_met, indeterminate, or unavailable
fourier.trial_construction: recipient base input is (x,y); donor input is (x_d,y_d) with donor sum s_d different from base sum s; the canonical recipient counterfactual is (x, (s_d-x) mod p), preserving the recipient first operand while changing only the abstract sum to s_d
fourier.trial_inputs: 256 fixed canonically ordered recipient/donor trials per comparison set and condition; no replacement
fourier.why_causal_abstraction: the donor contributes only an internal sum-code variable; the recipient's downstream weights must causally realize the donor sum as the recipient's own counterfactual behavior. Matching donor output logits or patching the final residual is neither the intervention nor the target.
fourier.wrong_mode_separation: off-diagonal support is disjoint from the primary diagonal support, has the same number of complex modes and real degrees of freedom, and is never used to fit, rank, or amend the primary mode subspace

hierarchical_analysis.category_rule: each category is resolved from its complete predeclared inputs as met, not_met, indeterminate, or unavailable; categories may overlap and are not success criteria
hierarchical_analysis.direct_student_contrast: student-cell median minus direct-teacher value for same seed, phase, and method
hierarchical_analysis.mid_phase: descriptive trajectory only, not a substitute for either primary landmark
hierarchical_analysis.missing_rule: no imputation; below-minimum population results are partial descriptive outputs with inferential fields unavailable
hierarchical_analysis.multiplicity: Holm adjustment within each endpoint x hard/soft family; architecture, basis, method-disagreement, null, and frontier results are explicitly descriptive
outcome_categories: teacher phase effect persists in both student conditions
students of one teacher vary materially
all distilled students become similarly compressible
results depend strongly on discovery method or fidelity definition
stable functions enable recovery while realization controls packing
the predecessor transition disappears under predictive fidelity
hierarchical_analysis.population_estimand: arithmetic mean of within-seed paired differences over the fixed matched population
hierarchical_analysis.primary_contrast: stable post-grokking minus pre-grokking within teacher seed
hierarchical_analysis.tests: two-sided exact sign-flip test for each four-cell primary family when matched n <=20; Monte Carlo 100000 fixed draws otherwise
hierarchical_analysis.uncertainty: 95% teacher-seed bootstrap percentile interval with 10000 domain-separated resamples

machine count and hardware class for every worker
qualified CPU, CUDA, or MPS status per hardware class

orchestration_boundary.export: sealed bundle to a Stage 14 verified destination, resumable transfer, independent byte/hash verification, and no source deletion
orchestration_boundary.gate_visibility: only completeness, failures, resources, storage, and integrity; no comparative scientific direction
orchestration_boundary.launch_blocker: if no verified configuration completes the protected core within H_science, block launch pending prospective amendment
orchestration_boundary.optional_admission: Task 3, then Task 4, then Task 5; only after protected completion is secure and only when the entire next manifest increment fits measured remaining capacity

capacity_equations: training_capacity = sum over machines and intervals of qualified_training_rate * usable_interval_seconds * measured_efficiency
hard_concrete_capacity = analogous sum using model-in-loop rate
exact_capacity = analogous sum using standalone CPU exact rate
host CPU support reservations are subtracted before standalone CPU capacity is computed
school_mac_branch.hardware_classes: class k records machine count M_k, CPU cores, RAM, optional MPS device, and disk quotas
school_mac_branch.optional_rule: after protected completion is secure, admit Task 3, then Task 4, then Task 5 only when measured remaining interval capacity can finish the entire next increment
school_mac_branch.pass_rule: protected core must finish within H_science with memory/storage quotas and audit reserve intact; otherwise launch blocks
school_mac_branch.permitted_hours: availability intervals I_{k,m}; capacity is integrated over intervals, never count*nominal wall time
school_mac_branch.qualified_rates: r_train_cpu[k], r_hc_cpu[k], r_exact_cpu[k], and optional r_train_mps[k]/r_hc_mps[k] only after exact and semantic MPS qualification
school_mac_branch.schedule_rule: run the dependency-closed protected DAG against actual intervals; CPU-only is mandatory when MPS is absent or unqualified

orchestration_boundary.scientific_dag: complete dependency-closed P3 manifest generated from approved RD-001 through RD-012 values

scientific_window.stage14_binding: H_total = total qualified permitted hours across verified availability intervals

tiering.additional_capacity_rule: unused capacity may run only the next preordered optional item and may not add or change a primary estimand
tiering.balance_rule: fixed assignments are balanced by seed order, phase, condition, and architecture/basis; unavailable cells remain unavailable with no replacement
tiering.optional_increment_rule: each task increment has its own sealed manifest/hash; after protected completion is secure, admit only the next increment when measured remaining capacity can finish it; a terminal failure is retained and never replaced
